Instrumented cell, IM-11 and IM-12

The template alarms and sort carry the week-to-week load; the control-chart rules (at their deployed limits of 4.05 and 2.70 sigma) and drift signals are the layers added on every shot. Rules 4 and 5 of the audit chart are not deployed on every shot (see the ML overview for why).
